newsitem.title: USA: Drew to buy 800,000 shares from chairman.
newsitem.headline: Drew to buy 800,000 shares from chairman.

text.p: Drew Industries Inc on Thursday said it would buy 800,000 shares from its chairman, Edward Rose III, at $26 each.
The stock represents about 15 percent of the company's outstanding shares and about half of those owned by Rose.
After the transaction, Rose will own 841,740 shares and a partial interest in an additional 86,200 shares, representing about 20.3 percent of Drew's outstanding shares.
Rose said in a statement that he decided to sell the shares to diversify his investments. In addition, he said he intended to remain active in managing Drew and would continue as chairman.
